title: Path of Exile 2 0.5.1 — Atlas Passives, Lineage Support and Runes QoL
summary: 0.5.1 added Atlas passives, Lineage Support, new elemental passives and Runes QoL. This page maps those changes to the Builds and Guides they affect.
description: A feature patch page for 0.5.1. It covers the extra Atlas passive points, Lineage Support, elemental passives and Runes improvements without mirroring the official notes.
author: Exile2 Guides Editorial Team
imageAlt: Waystones, the Atlas map device reagent tied to the 0.5.1 Atlas changes

sections.title: Player impact in 30 seconds
paragraphs: 0.5.1 added extra Atlas Passive points, Lineage Support, new elemental passives and Runes QoL on top of the 0.5.0 base.
The pages most affected are Atlas tree guides, any Build that uses Lineage Support or the new elemental passives, and Runes of Aldur pages.
This is a feature patch, not a content drop; old Atlas routing and Build trees need a re-check.

items.question: Is 0.5.1 a content update?
answer: No. 0.5.1 is a feature patch that extends the 0.5.0 systems with Atlas passives, Lineage Support and Runes QoL.
It does not add a new league or endgame system.

items.question: Which Builds are affected?
answer: Builds using Lineage Support or the new elemental passives are the most exposed.
Ordinary Builds mainly need a tree re-check, not a rebuild.
